content: Stability and/or coherence is not required In order to be able to clearly separate the aspect of stability from coherence it is possible to use the roles dpgDoesNotRequireCoherency to express that a group of VariableDataProto- type s explicitly does not require consistency . Likewise, regDoesNotRequireStability can be used to express that for a group of RunnableEntity s stability with respect to data access is not required.
